item.title: Blockchain.com Secures Full Cayman VASP License, Expands Regulated Services
item.summary: Blockchain.com has obtained a definitive Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) custody services license from the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority (CIMA), strengthening its regulatory footprint and expanding its ability to offer compliant digital asset services.
